title: Favorite trumpet and bass players
summary: Glass names Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly, Walter Blue, Bob Anthony and Joe Doyard as good trumpeters, and the Moran family and Simon on bass.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how
